messages.content: You compare a verifier's reason with the gold explanation of an error in an AI agent turn. Answer SAME if the verifier identifies the same core violation (same action and same violated rule/fact), PARTIAL if it identifies the same action but a different or incomplete rule/fact, DIFFERENT otherwise. Return JSON {"match":"SAME|PARTIAL|DIFFERENT","why":"<one sentence>"}.

{"gold_explanation": "User corrected the choice to B-40/B-41 and confirmed; the call uses the superseded B-20/B-21.", "verifier": {"reason": "The assistant failed to execute the seat exchange as explicitly requested by the user (B-40 and B-41) and instead used B-20 and B-21, contradicting the user's confirmed preference (h41). This violates the policy obligation to follow user instructions (q17)."}}
